title: Moving a booking to a time that overlaps its old time is allowed

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: rescheduleBooking places the new booking before cancelling the old, and validateAndPlaceBooking counts the old row as a booked range, so moving a 60 minute session 30 minutes later fails with 'too close to another booking'. Fix: drop the row named by rescheduledFrom from the conflict ranges (the unique-start guard still holds).

DONE 2026-11-21: validateAndPlaceBooking drops the row named by rescheduledFrom (.id !== rescheduledFrom) from both the exact-start check and the buffered booked ranges, so a 60 minute booking can move 30 minutes later. Overlap with any other booking still refuses, and the unique index still blocks the identical start. Tests in lib/spaces/booking.test.ts (a reschedule ignores the booking it replaces).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
